# TRL-EMIT-0006: Literal text contains the GitHub expression delimiter

- Severity: warning
- Exit class: blocked
- Area: EMIT
- Since: 0.1.0
- Status: active
- Fidelity: needs-manual

## Remediation

Rewrite the value without `${{`; GitHub evaluates it before the shell or the action sees it, and offers no escape.

## Example

```json
{"code": "TRL-EMIT-0006", "severity": "warning", "params": {"field": "<field>"}}
```
